answer: An agent economy can resist Sybil attacks by requiring each identity to lock a deposit before earning fees, then randomly auditing its signed work and slashing the deposit when agents collude or duplicate identities. Honest agents build reputation across tasks, while fresh accounts face low limits, so spawning thousands brings little influence. The attacker must fund every copper identity, survive audits, and risk losing stake, making fake identities costly even at the glacier’s nadir.
